# Understanding our planet *through spatial data.*

:::: {.more-about-grid}

::: {.more-about-photo}
![](images/image_park.JPEG){.profile-photo}

::: {.more-about-content}

I work at the intersection of environmental science, geospatial analysis, and data science. I use GIS, remote sensing, statistical modeling, and programming to investigate environmental change and transform complex spatial data into reproducible insights and accessible visualizations.

## Selected Projects {#selected-projects}

A selection of research and applied projects exploring environmental change, spatial patterns, and geospatial data workflows.

<span class="more-info-number">01 / GEOSPATIAL DATA ENGINEERING</span>

### Wildfire Resilience Data Package

The project provides programmatic access to 82 wildfire resilience raster layers, with metadata discovery and spatial data retrieval.

<span class="more-info-number">02 / WILDFIRE & ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE</span>

### Eaton and Palisades Fires Analysis

The analysis combines fire-related imagery and environmental justice indicators to examine the geographic and social dimensions of wildfire impacts.

<div class="project-tags">
  <span>Python</span><span>Remote Sensing</span><span>Landsat</span><span>Environmental Justice</span>

<span class="more-info-number">03 / BIODIVERSITY & REMOTE SENSING</span>

### Biodiversity Intactness in Phoenix, Arizona

A spatial assessment of changes in biodiversity intactness across Phoenix, Arizona, using raster data from Microsoft Planetary Computer.

<div class="project-tags">
  <span>Python</span><span>STAC</span><span>Raster Analysis</span><span>Planetary Computer</span>
</div>

[View GitHub repository ↗](https://github.com/hylaea-miller/Biodiversity-Intactness-Index-change-in-Phoenix-AZ){.more-info-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}
:::

::: {.more-info-card data-href="https://github.com/hylaea-miller/Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture"}
<span class="more-info-number">04 / MARINE SPATIAL ANALYSIS</span>

### Prioritizing Potential Aquaculture Areas

A geospatial suitability analysis integrating raster and vector datasets to identify potential areas for aquaculture.

<div class="project-tags">
  <span>R</span><span>QGIS</span><span>Raster Analysis</span><span>Map Algebra</span>
</div>

[View GitHub repository ↗](https://github.com/hylaea-miller/Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture){.more-info-link target="_blank" rel="noopener"}

::: {.more-info-card data-href="posts/223-blog-post/texas_blackout.html"}
<span class="more-info-number">05 / EXTREME WEATHER & SOCIOECONOMIC IMPACTS</span>

### Identifying the Impacts of Extreme Weather

A spatial analysis of the February 2021 power outages in Houston. The project combines satellite nighttime lights, road networks, building data, and socioeconomic indicators to investigate the geographic distribution of impacts.

<div class="project-tags">
  <span>R</span><span>GIS</span><span>VIIRS</span><span>OpenStreetMap</span><span>Census Data</span>
</div>

[Read project analysis ↗](posts/223-blog-post/texas_blackout.html){.more-info-link}
:::

::: {.more-info-card data-href="posts/222-blog-post/index.html"}
<span class="more-info-number">06 / LAND-COVER CHANGE & STATISTICAL MODELING</span>

### Analyzing Deforestation Drivers in MATOPIBA

The project applies statistical modeling to investigate relationships between vegetation loss and human activities using MapBiomas data.

<div class="project-tags">
  <span>R</span><span>MapBiomas</span><span>Gamma Regression</span><span>Statistics</span>
</div>

[Read project analysis ↗](posts/222-blog-post/index.html){.more-info-link}
:::

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".clickable-card[data-href]").forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
      if (event.target.closest("a")) return;

      window.open(card.dataset.href, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
    });

    card.setAttribute("role", "link");
    card.setAttribute("tabindex", "0");

    card.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
      if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
        event.preventDefault();
        window.open(card.dataset.href, "_blank", "noopener,noreferrer");
      }
    });
  });
});
</script>
